reasoning: A single clockwise circular arrow universally signifies refresh, reload, restart, reset, or renew. While it is an abstract UI action symbol, it fits tasks centered on rebooting devices, resetting systems, or handling general renewals when no concrete physical object icon applies, though specific nouns (like a passport or tire) should always take priority.
